<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ppos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
def pposP(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='P':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
def nall(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
print("before: player",ppos(current_frame),"P",pposP(current_frame),"N",nall(current_frame))
for (r,c) in [(33,33),(33,39),(33,45)]:

    if lr.get('done') or lr.get('level_completed') or lr.get('game_over') or lr.get('run_complete'):
        print("STOP terminal"); break
</parameter>
</function>

def ppos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
def pposP(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='P':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
def nall(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
